Selected work

RP 706-3020 industrial hopper assembly

A frame-mounted hopper assembly with a top enclosure, several hopper stations and a conical discharge hopper. I prepared the model in Autodesk Fusion 360 and produced the photorealistic render and turntable animation you see above.

  • Prepared the model for presentation in Fusion 360.
  • Produced the rendered still and the turntable animation.
  • Improved the visuals with image post-processing.

RP 706-2371 scissor lifting conveyor

A belt conveyor mounted on a scissor lift, with a blue gear motor at one end, a vertical frame at the conveyor and a welded base frame with levelling foot pads. The animation shows the full assembly turning on a turntable.

  • Prepared the assembly for presentation.
  • Produced the rendered still and the turntable animation.

KYN-ARM-6P, portable modular robotic arm (Rev A)

A six-degree-of-freedom arm designed to be portable and modular. I documented it as a complete engineering package so the design can be reviewed, costed and built.

  • Designed the arm as a modular assembly.
  • Prepared the engineering drawings and the bill of materials.
  • Built an interactive HTML visualization to present the design.
6degrees of freedom. Portable, modular, drawings and BOM included.
